name: azzurro-insights
description: AI-powered hotel review intelligence platform for Azzurro Hotels

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "SERVER,CLIENT" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names "SERVER,CLIENT,AI" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "cd ai-worker && ./scripts/start.sh"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && cd ai-worker && ./scripts/setup.sh
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client && npm run test:ai
